sources.title: PP-OCRv5_mobile_det: open language model | AxForge
sources.snippet: PP-OCRv5_mobile_det is a text detection model developed by Baidu for the PaddleOCR framework. It is designed to identify text in images, including handwriting, vertical, rotated, and curved text, across English, Chinese, and Japanese.
